rss_stability_vs_leak_proof.reported_rss_measurement: 5,000 batches, 150,000 samples, +1.21 MB RSS change (326.85 MB to 328.06 MB)
rss_stability_vs_leak_proof.scientific_assessment: STABLE RSS IS INSUFFICIENT TO PROVE ZERO LEAKS: While process RSS showed stable memory without gross unbounded growth, OS-level RSS reflects C-level allocator arena paging, not fine-grained object lifecycle. The tracemalloc heap audit verified that active Python heap plateaued at ~185 KB after initial tree warm-up, with zero cumulative heap growth between batch 400 and batch 1000 (+0.04 KB delta). Together, the dual RSS and tracemalloc measurements confirm true heap bounded stability.
